source: 上外版必修第二册 Unit 3 Grammar in Use:-ing/-ed forms used as attributives。-ing 作定语表主动/正在进行,-ed 作定语表被动/已完成;辨析看修饰词与名词的主被动关系。句子地道、答案唯一、零术语、食物主题。

points.overview: 当被修饰的名词是动作的发出者、或动作正在进行时,用 -ing 形式作定语:a boiling pot(=a pot that is boiling)、the cooking method、a crying child。
当被修饰的名词是动作的承受者、或动作已经完成时,用 -ed 形式作定语:fried rice(=rice that has been fried)、a frozen meal、cooked food、a hidden toy。

points.point: -ing vs -ed 辨析 + 复合形容词
points.overview: 根据名词与动词的主被动关系选 -ing 还是 -ed:a man eating fish(人主动吃→-ing)vs fish eaten by a man(鱼被吃→-ed);情感类 -ing 修饰物、-ed 修饰人(a boring meal / a bored guest)。

questions.stem: "Be careful — that ____ pot of soup is very hot."
questions.explanation: 锅里的汤正在沸腾,主动/正在进行 → boiling。

questions.stem: "My grandmother taught me a simple ____ method for noodles."
questions.explanation: 表用途的方法(动名词作定语),the cooking method → cooking。

questions.stem: "The ____ smell of fresh bread filled the whole kitchen."
questions.explanation: 香味主动'诱人'→ inviting。

questions.stem: "A ____ child at the next table wanted some of the cake."
questions.explanation: 孩子主动在哭,正在进行 → crying。

questions.stem: "We sat around the table watching the ____ steam rise from the dumplings."
questions.explanation: 蒸汽主动上升,正在进行 → rising。

questions.stem: "The ____ water in the pot was ready for the noodles."
questions.explanation: 水正在沸腾 → boiling water。

questions.stem: "There is a ____ room next to the kitchen where the family eats."
questions.explanation: 用于吃饭的房间(动名词作定语),the dining room → dining。

questions.stem: "The ____ guests at the party could not wait to taste the cake."
questions.explanation: 客人主动在等待 → waiting guests。

questions.stem: "A sweet, ____ cake sat in the centre of the festive table."
questions.explanation: 蛋糕主动'诱人'→ tempting。

questions.stem: "The ____ fire under the wok made the oil hiss loudly."
questions.explanation: 火主动在燃烧,正在进行 → burning fire。

questions.stem: "My host mother used a special ____ board to cut the vegetables."
questions.explanation: 用于切的板(动名词作定语),a cutting board → cutting。

questions.stem: "The ____ aroma of the spices made everyone hungry."
questions.explanation: 香气主动令人愉悦 → pleasing。

questions.stem: "We watched the ____ butchers slicing meat at the busy market."
questions.explanation: 屠夫主动在干活,正在进行 → working butchers。

questions.stem: "A ____ kettle on the stove told us the tea was almost ready."
questions.explanation: 水壶主动在'鸣响',正在进行 → whistling kettle。

questions.stem: "The ____ children hid under the table before the cake was sliced."
questions.explanation: 孩子们主动在笑 → laughing children。

questions.stem: "He bought a new ____ pan to fry the morning eggs."
questions.explanation: 用来煎的锅(动名词作定语),a frying pan → frying。

questions.stem: "The ____ crowd at the food market grew larger by noon."
questions.explanation: 人群主动在增多,正在进行 → growing crowd。

questions.stem: "A ____ pot of rice porridge bubbled gently on the stove."
questions.explanation: 锅正在冒热气,正在进行 → steaming pot。

questions.stem: "The ____ number of food stalls made the old street very lively."
questions.explanation: 数量主动在增长,正在进行 → increasing number。

questions.stem: "I love the ____ sound of vegetables hitting the hot oil."
questions.explanation: 声音主动'滋滋作响',正在进行 → sizzling sound。

questions.stem: "For dinner we had ____ rice with eggs and spring onions."
questions.explanation: 米被炒过,被动/已完成 → fried rice。

questions.stem: "On busy nights my host family often eats a ____ meal from the freezer."
questions.explanation: 饭被冷冻过,被动/已完成 → a frozen meal。

questions.stem: "Leaving some ____ food in your bowl is acceptable in China."
questions.explanation: 食物被做熟,被动/已完成 → cooked food。

questions.stem: "There was a small toy ____ inside the kings' cake."
questions.explanation: 玩具被藏起来,被动 → a toy hidden inside(=which is hidden)。

questions.stem: "In the north, ____ dumplings are a favourite New Year food."
questions.explanation: 饺子被煮过,被动/已完成 → boiled dumplings。

questions.stem: "Near the sea, people enjoy ____ fish that is kept for the winter."
questions.explanation: 鱼被腌制保存,被动/已完成 → preserved fish。

questions.stem: "The cake is best served warm, straight from the ____ oven."
questions.explanation: 烤箱被加热,被动/已完成 → a heated oven。

questions.stem: "My mother placed a bowl of ____ soup beside my bed."
questions.explanation: 汤是在家做成的,被动/已完成的复合形容词 → homemade soup。

questions.stem: "We started the meal with several ____ vegetables served cold."
questions.explanation: 蔬菜被腌过,被动/已完成 → pickled vegetables。

questions.stem: "The market sold ____ meat that had been dried in the sun."
questions.explanation: 肉被晒干,被动/已完成 → dried meat。

questions.stem: "A ____ crown of golden paper sat on top of the cake."
questions.explanation: 纸冠被折成,被动/已完成 → a folded crown。

questions.stem: "The chef offered us some freshly ____ bread with the soup."
questions.explanation: 面包被烤,被动/已完成 → freshly baked bread。

questions.stem: "In British cooking there is a pudding ____ mostly with bread and butter."
questions.explanation: 布丁被做出来,被动 → a pudding made with(=which is made)。

questions.stem: "The host put a plate of thinly ____ beef in front of me."
questions.explanation: 牛肉被切片,被动/已完成 → thinly sliced beef。

questions.stem: "They served a bowl of long noodles ____ in a clear broth."
questions.explanation: 面条被煮在汤里,被动 → noodles cooked in(=which are cooked)。

questions.stem: "The supermarket had a whole shelf of ____ fruit in cans."
questions.explanation: 水果被装罐,被动/已完成 → canned fruit。

questions.stem: "We were each given a cup of freshly ____ coffee after the meal."
questions.explanation: 咖啡被冲泡,被动/已完成 → freshly brewed coffee。

questions.stem: "The recipe used ____ ginger instead of fresh ginger root."
questions.explanation: 姜被磨成粉,被动/已完成 → ground ginger。

questions.stem: "Each guest received a slice of cake with a ____ charm inside."
questions.explanation: 小饰物被埋在里面,被动 → a buried charm(=which is buried)。

questions.stem: "On the table were small bowls of ____ rice for each member."
questions.explanation: 强调'被蒸好'的米饭,被动/已完成 → steamed rice。

questions.stem: "The waiter ____ the dishes spoke very good English."
questions.explanation: 服务员主动上菜 → the waiter serving the dishes(=who served)。

questions.stem: "The dishes ____ by the waiter looked colourful and fresh."
questions.explanation: 菜被服务员端上,被动 → the dishes served by the waiter。

questions.stem: "The man ____ fish at the corner table was my host father."
questions.explanation: 人主动吃鱼 → the man eating fish(=who is eating)。

questions.stem: "The fish ____ by the man was a fresh sea sardine."
questions.explanation: 鱼被人吃,被动 → the fish eaten by the man。

questions.stem: "The cook ____ the soup added a little salt and pepper."
questions.explanation: 厨师主动做汤 → the cook making the soup(=who made)。

questions.stem: "The soup ____ by the cook tasted rich and warm."
questions.explanation: 汤被厨师做,被动 → the soup made by the cook。

questions.stem: "It was such a ____ meal that nobody spoke for a long time."
questions.explanation: 饭'令人满足',-ing 修饰物 → a satisfying meal。

questions.stem: "The ____ guests thanked the host for such a wonderful dinner."
questions.explanation: 客人'感到满足',-ed 修饰人 → the satisfied guests。

questions.stem: "The students ____ Chinese food for the first time looked curious."
questions.explanation: 学生主动尝试 → the students trying Chinese food(=who were trying)。

questions.stem: "The dish ____ at the new restaurant was a regional speciality."
questions.explanation: 菜被推荐,被动 → the dish recommended(=which was recommended)。

questions.stem: "The woman ____ behind the stall was selling rice cakes."
questions.explanation: 女人主动站着 → the woman standing behind(=who was standing)。

questions.stem: "The bread ____ by my host brother was still warm."
questions.explanation: 面包被买来,被动 → the bread bought by(=which was bought)。

questions.stem: "After the long lunch, the ____ tourists rested in the shade."
questions.explanation: 游客'感到累',-ed 修饰人 → the tired tourists。

questions.stem: "It had been a ____ day of visiting market after market."
questions.explanation: 一天'令人疲惫',-ing 修饰物 → a tiring day。

questions.stem: "The chef ____ the cake decorated it with a paper crown."
questions.explanation: 厨师主动烤蛋糕 → the chef baking the cake(=who baked)。

questions.stem: "The cake ____ in that small bakery was famous all over town."
questions.explanation: 蛋糕被烤,被动 → the cake baked in(=which was baked)。

questions.stem: "Everyone found the local cooking show quite ____."
questions.explanation: 节目'有趣',-ing 修饰物 → quite interesting。

questions.stem: "The ____ visitors asked the chef many questions about the recipe."
questions.explanation: 客人'感兴趣',-ed 修饰人 → the interested visitors。

questions.stem: "The family ____ around the table shared stories about food."
questions.explanation: 一家人主动围坐 → the family sitting around(=who were sitting)。

questions.stem: "The traditions ____ down for centuries still shape family meals."
questions.explanation: 传统被世代相传,被动 → traditions passed down(=which were passed)。
